page_title: AI and Machine Learning Products and Services

sources.entry: 3. Google Cloud AI - APIs for Google's AI services.

summary.name: Google Cloud AI and Machine Learning
summary.one_liner: Google Cloud's product page listing its AI and machine learning offerings, including the Gemini platform, Vision, Speech, Translation, Document AI, conversational AI, ML model platform, and AI infrastructure.
use_cases: Summarizing large documents with generative AI
Automatic speech recognition and real-time transcription
Training custom ML models and deploying them
summary.what_it_does: The page is a catalog of Google Cloud AI products grouped by category: generative AI (Gemini platform, Agent Platform tooling), machine learning and MLOps (Vertex-style model platform with 200+ models in Model Garden, Colab Enterprise, Workbench, BigQuery ML), speech, text, and language APIs (Natural Language, Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech, Translation), image and video APIs (AutoML Vision, Vision API, Video Intelligence), and Document AI for turning unstructured documents into structured data. It also lists conversational AI products, AI infrastructure (GKE, Cloud Run with GPUs, TPUs/GPUs/CPUs), and a 2-3 week AI Readiness consulting program. Several products are described with short "good for" lists rather than technical specifications.
notable: Single catalog covering generative AI, ML/MLOps, speech, vision, document, and conversational AI APIs
Vector search with ScaNN index in BigQuery, AlloyDB, and Spanner
Access to 200+ models in Model Garden including Gemini
New customers get up to $300 in free credits
caveats: Cloud AI products carry their own SLA terms and may have different latency or availability guarantees than other Google Cloud services
Paid usage beyond the introductory free credits; pricing is pay-as-you-go and quotes require contacting sales
